source: Frozen DEV-041 checkpoints, previously inspected DEV-042 evaluation excluded from all fitting, calibration and scoring
purpose: Separate transfer calibration from head-only learning of causal event order; avoid interpreting writer scale and un-tuned reservoir as architectural necessity

arms.name: original_head
arms.intervention: No new training, old DEV-041 threshold

arms.name: calibration_only
arms.intervention: Fit positive temperature and positive-slope Platt logistic map on fresh order-calibration logits, with current recurrent weights and original head frozen

arms.name: refit_uniform
arms.intervention: Freeze encoder, recurrent writer, query encoder and read adapter; retrain new 44D MLP head at fixed equal budget with 0/10/50% order-train cases; fit calibration after head training

head_optimizer.loss: uniform CE across all three queries and eight entities plus focus CE on mature target wait, equal 0.5 weights
head_optimizer.initialization: copy archived original head and restore for every mix fraction

calibration.selection: select calibration method by mean all-entity NLL on fresh disjoint calibration cases, ties identity > temperature > platt
calibration.decision_threshold_selection: minimum physical cost on calibration only; no benchmark/eval threshold selection
calibration.notes: Positive monotonic logit calibrators do not change within-pair ranking. No isotonic in bounded pilot because it can introduce exact ties; defer isotonic to prospective separate ablation.

primary.name: paired_target_wait_ranking
primary.population: mature 96 held-out causal order pairs per seed (at+after)
primary.definition: fraction of pairs where score P(wait-failure|cancelled)>P(wait-failure|scheduled); ties count 0.5; original probability score and calibrated probability score reported separately
primary.comparison: Within frozen trainable and random MTSK, head-only mixes 0 vs 0.1 vs 0.5; present all seed values, no promotion threshold

secondary: Brier/NLL for wait and service on all entities
negative performance on old-distribution validation separately
per-pair retrospective oracle threshold ceiling, not model selection
last-event and exact public-history cost references
integrity: no old DEV-042 cohort used anywhere, including selecting methods
all pretrained backbone weights byte-identical after fitting and after model restore
one benchmark corpus per study, paired histories held together
checkpoint, fit-manifest and all logits archived
independent audit reconstructs physical decisions from public simulator
limitations: this tests head transfer, not tuned random reservoir gain/decay; DEV-044 should tune frozen reservoir with equal budget
synthetic known-ID environment; last-event insufficient only on this constructed task
temperature scaling alone cannot fix ranking or force classification >50% without bias/threshold changes
oracle pairwise threshold accesses evaluation labels and is diagnostic only
no claim about full CDL/CASM/OSM integration
